doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Goals and the films she would like to score
summary: Liston says she never set goals, just did what she was told, though she'd like to write film music, and aims only to be the best she can.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: No. I just went on and did whatever they told me to do. But I would like to – I haven’t written for films – just films that doesn’t say anything.
It’s not political. Just a beautiful film.
Yeah. I would like to do that.
Would you say that would be your heart’s goal right now?
It doesn’t matter if I do or if I don’t. I think maybe something in New York is waiting on me now.
When you were coming up, you never said, “I want to be the best” or whatever?
You never had that kind of . . .
You just knew that you were going to be the best. You didn’t have to say it, right?
But I have to be the best that I can do. I don’t know if it’s the best.
